name: Grow an Ore Farm
desc:
💎 Grow an Ore Farm! ⛏️
Plant ore seeds 🌱 Grow rare crystals 💠 Mine and sell for cash 💰

🛒 Buy seeds in the shop (restocks often!)
🌱 Equip a seed, plant it in your plot
⏳ Ores grow even while you're offline
⛏️ Mine fully grown rocks and sell them to get rich

💡 Level up your pickaxe, unlock rarer ores, and build your mining empire!

👍 Like & Favorite to support!
🎁 Join the group for free codes & updates!
